person_note: The book sustains two base narrative modes: John Corey narrates participating chapters in first person, while separate Asad Khalil chapters use third-person narration. The quotes independently expose both modes—especially the extended Corey narration in q00575 and the third-person, mind-access Khalil passage in q00571—and Publishers Weekly explicitly confirms that these chapter types alternate. Dialogue, maxims, generic “you,” and clipped fragments were not promoted to base-person evidence. The authorized excerpt covers only the first-person opening, but the whole-book structural review resolves its limited scope; no credible contrary evidence remains.
